Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scans.

In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, which is the detail you noted in that same message. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You confirmed both lanes were working at 11:07.
